# ADR-3280: AWS tagging_compute: User-data containing secrets for launch template 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

User-data is readable to many operators and APIs.

## Decision

Launch templates MUST NOT include user-data containing secrets for launch template 8 (AWS-tagging_compute-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Secrets are fetched after boot from a vault.
